story: CMA proposes AI assistants on Google's UK Android and Chrome search choice screens, with annual prompts and an attribution requirement
OpenAI launches GPT-6 Sol and Luna at half the GPT-5.6 API price
Anthropic launches Claude Opus 5.5, 40% cheaper to run than Opus 5
Mistral acquires Paris adtech startup Pimento; team joins Vibe (formerly Le Chat)
Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Flash-Lite TTS with prompt-designed voices, 30-second consented voice replication and SynthID watermarking
UN Security Council holds session on AI and international security, with OpenAI and Anthropic attending
Proofpoint launches Agentic Data and AI Security system for monitoring AI agent behaviour
Alphabet Intrinsic open-sources Intrinsic Core robotics stack at ROSCon 2026
OpenAI opens the ChatGPT Ads app for Shopify to merchants outside the US from 23 September; UK has self-serve access; ChatGPT Ads now in 60+ countries at a $1bn run rate
Second run 2026-09-24: Salesforce AIforce (Claudeforce, Slackforce, Agentforce Coworker) from Dreamforce, announced 15 September so outside the 48-hour window

Second run 2026-09-24: Google Ads auto-upgrades automatically created assets and broad match to AI Max for Search from September 2026, a previously announced change with no new development in the window
Second run 2026-09-24: Alibaba unveils enterprise AgentCore platform and agentic cloud roadmap

Third run 2026-09-24: Google switches on native checkout in AI Mode and Gemini by default for eligible Shopify stores (rollout from 18 September, merchant emails 22 September); US-based stores selling to US customers only, so UK stores are ineligible, and the rollout dates are reported only from merchant emails
Third run 2026-09-24: Google Ads expands the AI Brief closed beta for AI Max to seven more languages and previews unified search term, asset and landing page reporting with no availability date
Third run 2026-09-24: Peec AI data shared on X says external links now appear in over 25% of Google AI Overviews, up from near 0%, with no published methodology
Third run 2026-09-24: Snorkel AI raises $350M at a $3.5B valuation

Google adds a multimodal search type filter to Search Console performance and generative AI features reports, covering Lens, Circle to Search, image uploads and Chrome Search this image, rolling out globally from 24 September
Amazon launches a Seller Assistant plugin for Anthropic's Claude (US beta) and Amazon Quick, plus 24/7 Seller Assistant workflows, announced 23 September
Google tests Gemini making phone calls to businesses for US Pixel 11 owners
Google Ads Recommended Investment Strategy adds Holistic and Growth budget modes
Google DeepMind's Koray Kavukcuoglu says Gemini 4 may ship well before year end
Reports that OpenAI will preview GPT-6 Cyber, possibly at Dev Day on 29 September
Grok Bot (SpaceXAI, beta 11 Aug 2026) vs Hermes Agent (Nous Research): guide for UK marketing teams
Adobe forecasts AI referrals to US retail sites up 130% YoY this holiday season (Thanksgiving +159%, Black Friday +95%, Cyber Monday +88%); 77% of AI shoppers more confident
Anthropic launches Claude Sonnet 5.5, 30%+ faster and up to 30% cheaper per task at $2/$10 per million tokens
Meta launches Meta Enterprise Platform (Muse, Meta Business Agent, Muse API) led by CJ Desai; no ads, pricing or availability detail
Google replacing Gemini Gems with stackable Skills from 17 November 2026 (in-app notice, no official docs yet)
OpenAI DevDay 2026 (29 September, keynote 10:00 PT) teased with 20+ launches; not yet happened at run time
Georgetown/UW study finds misleading AI summaries cut correct recall from 83.6% to 44.8%

OpenAI DevDay (29 September): plugin extensions and in-conversation plugin ranking open ChatGPT (1.2B weekly users) to native brand plugins, and dots always-on agents roll out to Pro and Business Premium in eligible markets
OpenAI GPT-6.1 Sol, near-Astra performance at a fifth of Astra's API token prices (DevDay, 29 September)
Somantra launches AEO Metrics Suite (Brand Mindshare, Consideration, Engagement scores across ChatGPT, AI Overviews, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity)
Multiply launches Ad Spend Recovery Agent for Google Ads, claiming 30% of budgets lost to off-intent traffic (vendor data, no methodology)
US government launches America.gov AI front door to federal services powered by Gemini and Grok
Lightspeed/Vaer AI study: ChatGPT, AI Mode and AI Overviews picked national chains over smaller retailers 90-94% of the time head-to-head; 'independent' in prompt cut chain share from ~44% to 9%
Google releases Gemini 4 Argon ($2/$10 per M tokens intro, 1M output) to Fairwind cyber partners only; wider access later
Google rolls AI Mode info monitoring (price drops, back in stock via Shopping Graph) out to all users globally, announced by Robby Stein on X on 28 September
OpenAI ChatGPT Ads adds bulk product feed campaign creation, product review status and carousel card reporting
Google AI contribution pilot pays ~100 publishers about 0.1% of their ad revenue for content used in AI Overviews, AI Mode and Gemini
FTC opens broad AI safety probe into OpenAI and Anthropic over agent incidents (Washington Post)

DemandSphere data (published 1 October) shows AI Overviews on 82% of tracked branded queries by 29 September, up from about 26% in early September; Chris Long finds them for 93% of brands tested; no Google announcement
OpenAI launches ChatGPT virtual Try On for clothing and a Favorites library globally on 1 October, powered by ChatGPT Images 2.5
Google updates its generative AI content guidance on 1 October to say all AI content, including titles, meta descriptions, structured data and alt text, must be manually fact-checked; no new penalty
Judge Amit Mehta dismisses Penske Media and Chegg antitrust suits over Google AI Overviews (30 September)
LiveRamp extends RampID to build custom audience segments for ChatGPT ads (1 October)
OpenAI cancels GPT-6.1 Astra release over safety test failures (reported 28 September, outside the 48-hour window)

OpenAI expands ChatGPT Ads measurement (ten attribution partners, Hightouch/Tealium/LiveRamp, geo-lift with Haus/Measured/WorkMagic, one-day view-through reporting, Negative Phrases, DV/IAS pilots) and announces a visual ad format tested in US image generation later in October (5 October)
OpenAI text watermarking under the EU AI Act, invisible watermark on eligible ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU over the coming weeks, opt-in for API, detector limited to researchers (5 October)
Google Ads to auto-extract promotions from websites into Search and PMax campaigns with location assets from 12 October, on by default (advertiser email reported by SER, 5 October)
Google Ads AI campaign localisation tool (beta) translates Search campaigns, keywords, images and landing pages into eight languages
Google says its spam updates use AI to find AI spam (SER, 5 October)
Anthropic, OpenAI, Google and Meta executives testify at NYC Council hearing on AI risks (5 October)
OpenAI rolls GPT-6 with Intelligent UI (interactive comparisons, maps, model-built tools) out to all ChatGPT tiers from 7 October, Free and Go from 8 October; web-search answers start 44% sooner
Google opens SynthID Detector to everyone globally in English (7 October), checks images, video and audio from Google, OpenAI, NVIDIA, Kakao and soon Apple
Radisson ChatGPT plugin case study, visit-to-booking conversion about 1.5x organic search (July-August 2026), plus ChatGPT ads with over half of bookings via view-through
Anthropic launches Claude Haiku 5.5, its fastest and cheapest small model, for high-volume work (7 October)
Google Merchant Center adds a UCP integration hub (Search Engine Roundtable, 7 October)
Google AI Overviews add an Add to Calendar feature (Search Engine Roundtable, 7 October)

Microsoft adds Topics Portfolio (beta) to the AI Performance report in Bing Webmaster Tools on 13 October, grouping grounding queries into topics with Topic Size, Sites Cited and Queries, plus opportunity queries where other sites are cited and yours is not

Google releases Gemini 4 Argon broadly on 13 October, globally via the API ($2/$10 intro pricing until 30 November) and in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers only, as an opt-in model
Meta releases Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full frontier models on 12 October, behind a $20 or $100 Muse subscription and the Meta Model API at $4/$20 per million tokens, no advertiser tools
Google Ads AI Max for Search adds a search terms and ad combinations report, appearing in some accounts (Search Engine Land, 13 October), no Google announcement found
Google tests pharmaceutical and prescription drug text and Shopping ads in AI Mode and AI Overviews, US only (Google statement to Adweek, 13 October)
Google job listing says Discover will become a hyper-personalised concierge experience (13 October), a plan signalled by a job post only

Meta (6 October) and TikTok (5 October) AI ad tools for Advertising Week New York 2026, Meta checkout tests in Business Agent on Messenger and Meta AI, Advantage+ video generation GA, ads MCP server drafts and approvals, TikTok Buy Direct and Shopping Assistant in eligibility-based tests, Search Ads on Smart+, TikTok Ad Network for US advertisers, TikTok for Business MCP connectors; on-demand article on UK availability

Google Ads announces channel prioritisation (high/low priority tiers) and budget allocation (best-effort daily % cap on low priority channels) for Search, Shopping, PMax and Demand Gen on 14 October; Search campaigns with Display Expansion migrate in February 2027

ChatGPT links appear to drop utm_source=chatgpt.com and the referrer since GPT-6, so ChatGPT visits show as direct (Cedric Huesler LinkedIn analysis of ~500 pages, SER 14 October); no OpenAI statement and possibly a bug
OpenAI assigns human ChatGPT Ads Account Managers to advertisers (email posted on X, SER 14 October)
Google tests the AI Mode left sidebar on the main search results page (spotted on X, SER 14 October)
Anthropic warns small AI models could soon self-replicate across internet-connected devices (Reuters, 13 October)
xAI releases Grok Voice 3.0 speech-to-speech model with unchanged API pricing (14 October)

Google announces five link changes to AI Mode and AI Overviews on 15 October (inline links higher, test of an official websites section at the top of task responses, Preferred Sources news carousels to more markets, thumbnails on related links, clickable creator names on AI Mode video); Preferred Sources use up more than 7x in 2026
ChatGPT utm_source=chatgpt.com tag returns after a bug, per Adobe's Cedric Huesler relaying OpenAI (fix from about 2am PT 15 October), referrer still missing; no OpenAI statement
Meta to switch product browsing on by default for existing ads from 28 October unless advertisers opt out (14 October, secondary reports only)
Raptive survey of 3,083 US consumers finds trust in an AI answer is 42% with no source shown (14 October)
OpenAI rolls out GPT-Live-1.1 and GPT-Live-1.1 Quip in ChatGPT Voice with new language voices (15 October release notes)
Notch founders join OpenAI's Ads team as OpenAI expands self-service ad buying

Meta's updated Commercial Terms (effective 30 October 2026) authorise crawlers and test credentials on domains associated with a business; the UK English edition says Meta may use the content to train its products, the US edition names advertising and business products; no robots.txt mention (Nieman Lab 15 October, Andy Stone denial 16 October)

Google launches Universal Cart in US Search (AI Mode) and the Gemini app on 15 October, multi-retailer cart with price tracking, promo codes and Google Pay checkout via UCP; US only, no UK plans stated
404 Media reports ChatGPT advertisers can target users by email, phone number, device ID and prompts (15 October); paywalled, no OpenAI documentation found
Google Ads lead forms add lead scoring, marking qualifying answers to custom questions (SER 16 October, no Google announcement)
ChatGPT launches Slides for building and presenting decks (aggregator-listed 16 October)
Anthropic research says agent work hours outnumber employees 6:1 and junior hiring is falling at Anthropic
Manual Focus AI Shortlist study, UK indoor cycling (smart trainers, apps, smart bikes) across six AI engines
Manual Focus Light Meter launch, why AI visibility needs repeated runs, separate engines and confidence ranges

OpenAI switches on ChatGPT Ads creative enhancements by default for new and existing campaigns from 29 October 2026 (help centre, the advertiser email says 30 October), rewriting headlines and descriptions, translating, resizing images and changing destination URLs with no per-version approval
Google begins testing ads in AI Mode for users who connect apps through Personal Intelligence, help doc updated (SER 19 October), connected apps not available in the UK or EU

Redact finds 102 hidden AI-only instruction blocks on 80 WhatsApp help pages telling chatbots not to mention regulators or GDPR, removed by 18 October, WhatsApp says a bug exposed its support chatbot's instructions (WIRED 19 October)
Google appears to drop the AI Overview label on some desktop AI Overviews for shows and movies (SER 20 October, Glenn Gabe on X, unconfirmed by Google)
OpenAI adds an optional 12-hour prompt cache to its API for persistent agents (20 October changelog)
Netflix cuts its 2026 ad revenue target from $3 billion to $2.7 billion in its Q3 shareholder letter (PPC Land, 20 October)

Three studies (Marie Haynes 21 October, The SEO Works benchmark to August 2026, Kevin Indig Growth Memo 19 October) find AI assistants send 0.62% to 2.6% of Google organic traffic, convert 1.18x to 4.5x organic but 0.67x paid, and show no reliable link from AI visibility to direct or branded traffic (SER roundup 22 October)

Walmart launches Agent Gateway, an MCP server letting approved AI agents search inventory and buy on Walmart and Sam's Club, with Agent Profiles and spending limits next month (TechCrunch 21 October, US)
Google Ads customer lifecycle goals updates before the holidays, high value mode in Shopping, wider retention goals and percentage multipliers (SER 22 October)
LinkedIn job title, industry and seniority targeting available for CTV buys through Google DV360 in the US (22 October)
Will Critchlow says Search Console now shows AI visibility data (X post, no Google announcement found)
OpenAI frontier models and Codex coming to Google Cloud Model Garden and Marketplace (21 October)
